verdict.rationale: Synctera is clearly API-first. Its docs cover APIs for personal and business customers, accounts, cards, internal transfers, ACH, wires, RDC, KYC/KYB, disclosures, webhooks and EDD, and a public OpenAPI spec is served. However, there is a separate operational platform for workflows and collaboration with the bank partner. Its learning-center items, such as team admin access grants, employee case notifications and user-permissioned external-account linking, read as UI-side functions with no stated API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage evidence for console functions (team/user admin, case management, notifications), and independent hands-on corroboration.
